description: Implements ADR-005 decision 7. A per-user daily synthesis budget set ~10–25× the heavy-user rate (heavy ≈ 2 synth/day → cap ≈ 25–50/day) so real users never hit it. Purpose is abuse/runaway protection (a misbehaving client looping zug_end_session), NOT cost rationing — COGS is ~$1/mo even for heavy users. When the cap is exceeded, degrade to ADR-002's existing append-only path: keep recording observations locally, skip Haiku synthesis, resume next window. Never fail a session. Distinct from the per-IP request limiter in rate-limit.ts (which guards request rate, not the expensive operation). Counter lives in the per-user namespace/control plane. Acceptance: a loop of session-ends past the cap stops triggering synthesis but sessions still record and reconcile; normal users see no change.
title: Per-user synthesis cap (runaway/abuse guard, degrades to append-only)
